_comment: ENX Gateway MCP — template for attaching the Euronext internal gateway MCP server as a tool on an Azure AI Foundry agent. Fill server_url with the tenant's gateway MCP endpoint and replace allowed_tools with the actual tool names from the gateway's own tool listing (query the server's tools/list, then allowlist ONLY the tools the agent needs — least privilege). The bearer token must be stored in Azure Key Vault and injected at deploy time (e.g. by create_agents.py reading a Key Vault secret via managed identity, or an azd/pipeline variable) — NEVER commit a real token to this repository. Placeholders in {braces} are tenant-specific values.
